description_en: Deletes the DNS records for a specified host record
description_zh: 根据传入参数删除主机记录对应的解析记录
kebab_example: aliyun alidns delete-sub-domain-records --domain-name example.com --rr www --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteSubDomainRecords

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the client
parameters.name: user_client_ip

parameters.help_en:
The domain name.<props="china">You can call DescribeDomains (https://help.aliyun.com/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-29697.d_0) to obtain the domain name.</props>
<props="intl">You can call DescribeDomains (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0) to obtain the domain name.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
域名名称。<props="china">可通过调用DescribeDomains (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)获取</props>
<props="intl">可通过调用DescribeDomains (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)获取</props>
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The host record.

To resolve @.example.com, set the host record to '@' instead of leaving it empty
parameters.help_zh:
主机记录。

如果要解析@.exmaple.com，主机记录要填写”@”，而不是空
parameters.name: rr

parameters.help_en:
The type of the DNS record. If you do not specify this parameter, all types of DNS records for the subdomain are deleted.

Valid values (case-insensitive): A, MX, CNAME, TXT, REDIRECT_URL, FORWARD_URL, NS, AAAA, and SRV
parameters.help_zh:
解析记录类型。如果不填写，则返回子域名对应的全部解析记录类型。

解析类型包括(不区分大小写)：A、MX、CNAME、TXT、REDIRECT_URL、FORWORD_URL、NS、AAAA、SRV
parameters.name: type

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of DNS records that were deleted
TotalCount.description_zh: 被删除的解析记录总数
